Reference record and referenced Principal are separate types;identifier,kind,issuer,registry,route,integrity,scope,consumer,use,data field,decision,evidence and time are proposed qualified denotations.
Inclusive identity-or-record criterion and accountability/authorization linkage need source-owner precedence correspondence.
Stable identifier,kind,route,integrity and scope are exact proposed nominations;scope is separate governance metadata rather than copied identity content.
Issuer or registry is inclusive;exact optional fields are guarded only when declared present and unused selectors do not fabricate origins.
Resolved and explicitly unresolved states are mutually exclusive necessary declarations;actual resolver outcomes remain independent.
Only a resolved record requires exact governed Principal nomination and preserved identity authority;unresolved total selectors do not assert a referent exists.
Resolved stable identifier/kind agree with the Principal by declaration;actual identity/kind fidelity and alias equivalence need accepted maps.
No universal global uniqueness of references,Principals,identifiers or consumers is invented from one nominated referent.
Six minimal data classes are a proposed source-coordinate whitelist;governance metadata,privacy posture and actual data-classification maps remain unresolved.
Embedded field classes must be declared minimal and not secret/credential/excess;real content absence requires independent classification evidence.
Selected use matches reference data classes exactly to consumer-needed classes;a shared reference can have multiple consumers but this candidate requires compatible declared needs.
Actual minimality,necessity,retention,purpose and payload-versus-governance field distinctions are not established by flags.
Principal remains declared identity authority while copy,mutation,authentication,replacement and authority-proof inference declarations are excluded.
A Principal Reference is not an authentication credential,Person Reference,Role assignment or authority grant;independent actual facts remain possible.
Every selected authority decision nominates separate resolved/independent recorded grant evidence,currentAt time and scope;actual grant/evidence validity remains independent.
Evidence Principal agrees with a resolved reference;an unresolved reference does not fabricate identity resolution or automatically authorize a consequence.
CurrentAt is an evidence/time relation without invented timestamp order,clock validity or globally one-time evidence cardinality.
Source authority-decision meaning,including denial or unresolved cases,needs an accepted interpretation of separate current grant evidence.
Exact local actor-model-review and integrated consumer stay source evidence;no private routing content/meaning or real identity/credential data is imported.
Complete source character accounting and supplied finite T/I controls do not accept shared denotations,source fidelity,whole translation or whole-definition proof.
